metadata.description: Windows 11 reliability fixes for GitHub Copilot CLI: line endings, BOMs, encodings, PowerShell quoting.

plugins.name: windows-guard
plugins.description: Stops GitHub Copilot CLI from corrupting files on Windows. Restores line endings and strips BOMs after every edit, blocks bash-isms and unsafe shell writes in PowerShell, refuses edits that would destroy non-UTF-8 files, and coaches the model through quoting and edit-match failures.
